Visual loss due to amblyopia can be temporary or recoverable. In some cases, individuals may experience recovery of visual function in the previously normal eye after developing visual loss in the amblyopic eye. This is particularly true for older adults with a history of amblyopia who develop visual loss in their previously normal eye.

However, it's essential to note that there are instances where visual loss can be permanent. If you're concerned about your vision or suspect that you may have developed amblyopia, consult an eye doctor or healthcare professional for proper evaluation and guidance.
